qa_method: Independent re-solve from stem+choices before comparing proposed answer; then classical auxiliary meaning, connection, explanation, distractor, ID, answer-position, exact-duplicate, and high-similarity review.
ambiguity_review: Completion items use event-completion cues such as つひに・すでに・ただ今 and immediate transition to a following action; continuation items explicitly preserve the resulting state with 今も・日暮れまで・夜更くるまで・そのまま. Forms with 助動詞「り」 were checked to attach only to 四段活用の已然形 in this batch (咲けり・とまれり・帰れり・散れり・鳴れり・立てり・かかれり・通れり).
content_review: Confirmed that both たり and り can express completion or continuation, and distinguished them by whether the context focuses on an event reaching completion or on the resulting state continuing. All 25 stems had one defensible answer from stem+choices alone.
release_rule: These IDs passed independent content QA but still require the future revision-bound global semantic near-duplicate gate before production-bank approval.
